leads.description: Hiring project: practical digital improvements across Swiss business projects, working directly with founder Luca Bernardi. Remote freelance · Part-time, minimum 50% · Percentage negotiable We are looking for a resourceful freelancer to work directly with the founder across business projects in different sectors. What you will work on Build and improve landing pages, forms, simple dashboards and workflows using AI-assisted coding and other suitable tools. Prepare website copy, social posts, presentations and visual assets. Research providers, compare options, follow up on requests and present recommendations supported by sources. outreach.body:
Hi,

Saw your post: "[HIRING] Digital Projects & AI Assistant | Remote freelance 50%+ | French or Italian". This is exactly the kind of ai agents work I do.

Here is how I would approach it:
1. A short scoping call to lock the outcome (30 min).

I usually start with a small fixed-price pilot ($150-$500) so you can see it working before committing further.

Three questions so I can quote precisely: what does success look like, which tools are already in place, and what is your deadline?

Reply here or email me and I will send a 2-minute walkthrough of a near-identical build.

Reserve the pilot here (pay and I start immediately): https://paypal.me/7900861
Best,
